about_the_game:
An old tape replays your worst memory. Hoping to get rid of this memory once and for all, you go through it once more, you take control of this taped memory as it plays out. A camping trip, a fierce storm and your girlfriend vanishing near an abandoned mine. To follow her trail, you must scour the woods, gathering tools to breach the sealed entrance. But the mine is filled with unknown dangers and something seems to roams the dark. Can you survive the depths and find her, or will the memory never end?

In Buried Below, the experience starts with an interactive intro leading up to a camping trip gone wrong. During a storm, your girlfriend goes missing. Armed with key information previously provided by a clerk about a nearby abandoned mine, you venture out to explore the fast, free-roamable forest, needing maps for orientation. Gaining entry to the mine involves using items correctly to solve light environmental puzzles blocking your path.

Once inside, your survival depends on managing your lighter's fuel while navigating the tunnels. You'll need to use stealth, either hiding or creating distractions, to evade the creature that lurks below. Can you escape this desolate place, or will your memory never end? This is a compact, atmospheric survival horror experience.

Note: Features and details may change as the game is still in development.

Want to stay updated on Buried Below? The game is still in active development, and your support is crucial! Hitting the Wishlist button not only makes sure you're notified on launch day but also greatly helps the game's visibility on Steam, which is invaluable for a smaller project. Wishlist today and follow along!

content_descriptors.notes:
This game features atmospheric horror content that includes suspenseful situations and jump scares. Players will navigate dark, claustrophobic environments while being stalked by a creature. Contains creature related horror elements and potentially startling encounters. The story involves themes of searching for a missing person and survival. Some in-game music tracks may occasionally contain light swear words.

Buried Below does not include depictions of sexual acts, drugs, alcohol abuse, or self-harm, but it is intended for mature audiences due to its intense atmosphere and violent content. Player discretion is advised.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: WINDOWS 10+ (64-BIT)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-1135G7 (8) @ 2.420GHz or AMD FX™-6300 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

  • Additional Notes: Intergrated graphics can still run the game on lower settings, but a proper GPU is strongly recommended.
